title: FAQ
description: We've compiled a list of the most frequently asked questions to give you all the information you need to make an informed decision about your van conversion. From pricing and timelines to materials and customization options, we've got you covered.
body:
• Home
  • FAQ'S
Faq's

FAQ

How much does a campervan conversion cost?

We have multiple different tiers of pricing starting from $53,595+ with our Rainier Tier all the way to $127,395+ with our El Capitan Tier.

These prices do NOT include the van. 

What is the typical timeline for a campervan conversion?

Our build times are roughly 6-9 weeks long but can vary depending on how custom the design is.

Do I need to provide the van for the conversion, or can you source one for me?

No, you do not need to! We have partnered with local dealerships such as Ram, Mercedes, and Ford to help you find the best van at the right price.

What does custom actually mean?

We are fully custom. This means that we are able to achieve your desired layout with no hesitation. The only limitations will be from the shape of the van and certain materials that we do not work with.

What amenities or features can be included in the conversion?

There are an endless amount of amenities available to include in your custom campervan, although most of them include a bed, solar, running water, and more! Perfect for living full-time on the road.

Is it possible to have off-grid capabilities in the campervan?

Yes! We specialize in Off-grid campervan builds, utilizing Lithium batteries, solar panels, large water tanks, and more!

How does the electrical system in the campervan work?

Our vans run off of solar energy rather than needing to be plugged in like an RV. The Solar panels transfer electricity to our lithium batteries and then run everything at 12V with the inclusion of an inverter which will power 110V outlets.

Can you install solar panels for power generation?

Yes! Most of our builds include solar installation. 

Do you offer financing options for campervan conversions?

We sure do! We can help finance the build and the van together if needed or just finance the build on its own.

Can I choose the materials and finishes for the interior of the campervan?

You can select your preferred colors for paint, stain, flooring, and ceiling. We maintain a stock of all our materials, so you don’t need to worry about sourcing them yourself. 

What type of insulation is used in the conversion?

We use Havelock wool for our deluxe insulation package.

Is it possible to have a bathroom or shower in the campervan?

Absolutely! Most of our vans come with an outdoor shower but you can include an interior shower as well with the top 3 build tiers.

Can the campervan conversion accommodate a specific number of passengers?

It is variable depending on package but max of 6

Do you provide warranties for the conversion work?

Yes, we offer a 1-year warranty on all craft work and individual warranties for equipment.

Are there any maintenance or service requirements for the campervan after the conversion?

You must clean out the water tank, water purifier filter, clean solar panels, our service department can handle anything you cannot.

Are there any weight or towing restrictions to consider with the conversion?

No

Can you assist with shipping or delivery of the completed campervan?

Yes, wherever you are, we can and will deliver.

Do you offer any post-conversion support or assistance?

Yes, assistance after van delivery, and our service department is readily available for your needs.

Can I remove the Papago vinyl decals from the sides of the van?

The Papago branding decals are a permanent part of every build and are not removable or optional. We include them not only as a signature of quality and craftsmanship, but also as a necessary part of how we maintain our reputation, stand behind our work, and continue offering premium materials and support across every van we build.

Because of this, we’re unable to remove or omit branding; it’s part of what allows us to deliver the experience and build quality Papago is known for. We’ve designed the decals to be tasteful, durable, and complementary to every aesthetic, and we appreciate your understanding.

Service department

Frequently asked questions ordered by popularity. Remember that if the visitor has not committed to the call to action, they may still have questions (doubts) that can be answered.

What services does your service department offer for campervans?

Interior Installs, Exterior Upgrades, Heating/Cooling, Partial Builds, Flooring, electrical, etc..

Can you handle both minor repairs and major renovations for campervans?

Absolutely! Whatever you need fixed or added to your van build, we are the one-stop shop for you.

How experienced are your technicians in working with campervans?

Our service technicians are very skilled in their van building with many years of experience in this industry.

Do you work on campervans of all makes and models, or are there any limitations?

No limitations! If it has wheels and walls

What is the typical turnaround time for repairs or additions in your service department?

This varies from job to job but you can expect anything from a few hours of installation time to a few weeks or even longer if you need a partial build done.

Can you assist with diagnosing and fixing electrical issues in campervans?

We do have expertise in fixing electrical problems within campervan components but we do not work on the vehicle’s internal components.

Do you provide warranty coverage for the repairs or additions performed in your service department?

Yes, this varies for each project.

Can you help with installing solar panels, batteries, or other off-grid components?

Absolutely, this is our specialty.

How do I schedule an appointment with your service department?

You can visit our service center page on our website and request a service job.

Can you provide an estimate or quote for the services I need?

Yes, after acquiring all of the information about your service request, we will provide a quote for the job before starting on it.

Is there a waiting list or can I expect prompt service for my campervan?

As of now, we have a short list, although, there are some quick fixes that we may be able to squeeze in during our day. Always reach out to us before coming in!

Do you offer mobile repair services, or do I need to bring my campervan to your facility?

No mobile repair service as of now.

What sets your service department apart from other providers in the industry?

We are one of the only service providers in the west that is willing to service more than just our own campervans + we are the only service department that will service many different vehicle builds.
